newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan Life successor to be profitable--MOF quoted.
newsitem.headline: Nissan Life successor to be profitable--MOF quoted.

text.p: The new company that is expected to be set up to take over Japan's failed Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co will operate in a profitable manner, Jiji news agency quoted a key Ministry of Finance (MOF) official as saying on Friday.
"(The successor company), from the profitability point of view, looks manageable," Makoto Fukuda, the director of MOF's insurance department, was quoted as saying.
But Fukuda was also quoted as saying that he had not heard anything official on the finalisation of the scheme for Nissan Life.

Industry sources said on Wednesday that MOF and a life insurance group have already hammered out a framework to deal with the failed insurer and that it is expected to be unveiled on Friday at a news conference by the Life Insurance Association of Japan.
Under the scheme, a new company will be set up jointly by life insurers to liquidate the failed insurer, taking over its policies and managing them until they mature, the sources said.
